title: Figure 38: Evaluation of Object Sightings in Strategic Areas of the South Far West Region
description: Regional map of southern California and Baja California showing an outlined cross-shaped strategic area around Los Angeles (84 object sightings), linked to a pie chart of evaluations (Balloon 28.5%, Aircraft 19.0%, Unknown 16.7%, Other 14.3%, Astro 13.1%, Insuf. info. 8.3%). A second pie gives the "Balance of South Farwest Region" (19 object sightings). Caption: "FIGURE 38 COMPARISON OF EVALUATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS IN THE STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE SOUTH FARWEST REGION"; drawing B-7516, page 54.
